verdict.rationale: A state business-filing registry could plausibly publish versioned APIs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers the human-facing SOSPortal web platform (filing, searching, ordering) and its replacement of SOSDirect/SOSUpload. That migration is a product transition, not a versioned API with a documented deprecation policy, and nothing in the pack documents any API, versioning scheme, or deprecation policy.
